bagPolicy.summary: The athletics A–Z guide permits clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Medical exceptions are inspected; check concert-specific rules.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Alabama Athletics provides a Coleman Coliseum basketball parking map, but its A–Z guide does not specify concert parking lots or rates.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a concert rideshare pickup or drop-off zone in its Coliseum A–Z guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Levy operates the athletics concessions, which accept Mastercard, Visa, American Express and Discover. The venue prohibits outside food and drink except approved medically necessary snacks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: An elevator for guests needing access to higher rows is in the North Lobby. The first-aid room behind Sections N and O provides a private nursing area.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Coliseum A–Z guide says guests cannot leave and re-enter on a scanned ticket; every entry requires an unscanned ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For athletics games, public will call is at the North Doors and requires a photo ID; the ticket office opens two hours before weekend or evening tip-off. Concert will-call arrangements are not listed.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For basketball, all gates open 90 minutes before tip-off, with public entry at the north, east, south and west doors. Concert door times are not specified in this guide.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
